{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01UmG7ErtjwjqYAiM1coAMGF","type":"tool_result","content":"64\t\n65\t- [ ] Production runs Phase 1 for ≥ 7 days.\n66\t- [ ] Dashboards show `FEATURE_SENSOR_EMIT_V1=true` traffic decays to ≤ 0.1% (just dedup wins from the V2 path — no V1-only messages).\n67\t- [ ] Zero alert-engine errors correlated to `SensorReading` handling.\n68\t- [ ] Operator flips `FEATURE_SENSOR_EMIT_V1=false` in the staging environment first; monitor for 24h; then production.\n69\t\n70\t**Phase 2 → 3** (full cut-over to Rust sidecar):\n71\t\n72\t- [ ] Every tenant registered in `apps/sensor-ingestion/config.toml` `[ingest_backend.tenant_overrides]` → `rust`.\n73\t- [ ] `default_backend = \"rust\"` flipped in the policy snapshot via\n74\t      `admin-api-service` call (ADR-031 publishing path).\n75\t- [ ] `sensor-service` deployment with the MQTT listener module disabled — follow `docs/runbooks/sensor-ingest-rust-rollout.md` § \"Full cut-over\" block for the hand-off.\n76\t- [ ] V1 upcaster removal (a SEPARATE PR after Phase 3 has been stable for ≥ 30 days).\n77\t\n78\t---\n79\t\n80\t## Rollback\n81\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"878af741-90f4-4843-ae2f-041f9523dcdd","uuid":"662f394f-1d34-42fe-98b5-ed5b0d11b18e","timestamp":"2026-10-05T04:37:46.222Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-evidence-judge-32a4afab1a84/docs/runbooks/sensor-payload-v2-migration.md","content":"\n- [ ] Production runs Phase 1 for ≥ 7 days.\n- [ ] Dashboards show `FEATURE_SENSOR_EMIT_V1=true` traffic decays to ≤ 0.1% (just dedup wins from the V2 path — no V1-only messages).\n- [ ] Zero alert-engine errors correlated to `SensorReading` handling.\n- [ ] Operator flips `FEATURE_SENSOR_EMIT_V1=false` in the staging environment first; monitor for 24h; then production.\n\n**Phase 2 → 3** (full cut-over to Rust sidecar):\n\n- [ ] Every tenant registered in `apps/sensor-ingestion/config.toml` `[ingest_backend.tenant_overrides]` → `rust`.\n- [ ] `default_backend = \"rust\"` flipped in the policy snapshot via\n      `admin-api-service` call (ADR-031 publishing path).\n- [ ] `sensor-service` deployment with the MQTT listener module disabled — follow `docs/runbooks/sensor-ingest-rust-rollout.md` § \"Full cut-over\" block for the hand-off.\n- [ ] V1 upcaster removal (a SEPARATE PR after Phase 3 has been stable for ≥ 30 days).\n\n---\n\n## Rollback\n","numLines":18,"startLine":64,"totalLines":135}}}
